notes.title: Release Version 0.19: Lighting and Tutorial
notes.content: [h1]🚀 Release 0.19[/h1][p]🆕 [b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base building expanded with ladders, floors, walls, and metal doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Placeable wall clocks, new 2m tall door, and town terrace added.[/p][/*][*][p]New items: pickaxe, metal hammer, wooden hammer, bear trap, charcoal, sticks, decorative plants, leaves, coal icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting: bandages from cloth scrap, biomass from leaves, handcrafting vs. workbench recipes split, more recipe tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial quests added: collect iron plates/rods, recycling, weapon crafting, farming (bak choi), showering, drinking water, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]New quest types: conquer territory, fertilize crops, hire help for squad.[/p][/*][*][p]Jail area expanded with towers, reception, showers, props, openable cell doors, and warden NPC.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Visuals and World[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Altos sky system with stars, cloud exposure, and better noir skies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added volumetric fog, dust storms, subtle god rays, and auto exposure.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to ACES color grading, added HBAO for sharper edges, and Radiant GI.[/p][/*][*][p]MicroSplat terrain system with global texturing, glitter, wind, and blending.[/p][/*][*][p]Cars improved: faster, road-only, capped at 50 spawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain fixes, new curved road system, 1km more connected highways, bridges, and darker sidewalks.[/p][/*][*][p]Jail area colliders optimized; RoundHut interior, Cafe building, and props improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Yurt Village now has angels for a cultish atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖥 [b]UI and UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inventory screen updated: wider crafting UIs, new crafting category tabs, arms slot for wearables, player name/level shown.[/p][/*][*][p]Character shown in inventory with better scaling, symmetry, and blurred backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips improved: clearer recipe values, more recipes shown at once, bigger rejection messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotbar: bigger outlines, darker crouch indicator, rounder skill icons, shinier progress fill.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars redesigned: larger, genre-consistent, medical bars added.[/p][/*][*][p]Map view shows terrain and zooms; area view UI now fades in/out.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screens polished: blur, brighter background, clearer “Loading” text.[/p][/*][*][p]Options: taller factions screen, gamma slider, cursor fixes, round toggles.[/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 [b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Numerous null refs fixed across UI, bushes, factions, and quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet decals scaled properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Coffee machine/mugs collectible fix carried over.[/p][/*][*][p]Grappling hook no longer attaches to terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Player now resets if save file corrupts.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can’t use skills while dead; no ammo hint hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Cars no longer tick excessively and stick to roads.[/p][/*][*][p]Ragdolls simplified to Unity ragdolls; UMA expressions removed until stable.[/p][/*][*][p]Survival/UI polish: needs icons white, better blur, cleaner shadows, intro cutscene only once.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Version 0.18
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Release 0.18
[/h1][p][b]
🆕 New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wearables expanded: sombrero, cyber mask, propeller hat, conical hat, explorer hat, and various faction hats.[/p][/*][*][p]New items: bowls, plates, pretzel chair, hotdog, onigiri, soy drink, mugs, empty bottles, recycling machine, coffee machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Collectable food: kielbasa, soy food, coffee mugs, rat meat.[/p][/*][*][p]World expansion with Yurt Village, crater area, RedCanyon planning, Old Town district, and a 2km highway dividing the map.[/p][/*][*][p]New environment props: propaganda screens, wooden planks/palettes, beds, geodesic dome, flags with cloth physics.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎨 Visuals and World[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated lighting: yellower sky, bleaker colors, stronger split toning, less bloom and blur for a noir style.[/p][/*][*][p]Market, vending machines, and fuel station improved; new metallic mug and houseplants.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam capsule made more dreadful with new logo, eye icon, and text fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain fixes, new paths, lighter ground colors, and improved modular architecture organization.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🖥 UI and UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inventory reduced from 40 → 36 → 32 slots for added survival pressure.[/p][/*][*][p]Map view now allows zooming and panning, with a placeholder world map added.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer tooltips: illegal/recyclable tags, market values, reject hints.[/p][/*][*][p]Character creation UI polished: faction descriptions, better materials, reduced zoom, cleaner buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Options menu improvements: darker backgrounds, gamma slider, better contrast, rounder toggles.[/p][/*][*][p]Calendar and tutorial UI improved for clarity and visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotbar shows hotkeys, skill progress circles rounder, curfew and faction icons cleaner.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Numerous [b]null reference errors[/b] fixed across UI, prefab uses, and props.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ragdoll blending glitches, missing materials, projectile visuals, and dead robot skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Coffee machine logic corrected; mugs now properly collectible.[/p][/*][*][p]Rats now drop rat meat (not computers).[/p][/*][*][p]Survival needs tick down slower to ease pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Several unused assets, old prefabs, duplicate logs, and post-processing effects removed for performance and clarity.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Version 0.17
notes.content: [h1]🚀 Release 0.17[/h1][p]🆕 [b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Electricity with generators, solar panels, wind turbines and sockets.[/p][/*][*][p]Started working on wearables like hats, cat ears and wigs.[/p][/*][*][p]New tools: pipe wrench, fire axe, halligan bar, chainsaw.[/p][/*][*][p]Tesla coil and railgun turret as new defenses.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Visuals and World[/b][/p][list][*][p]Larger sky dome with better lighting, fog and shadows.[/p][/*][*][p]Character creation polished with clearer text and more environment clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]New props added: graffiti, posters, coffee machine, paintings.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified materials and post processing for cleaner visuals.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖥 [b]UI and UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inventory cut from 40 to 36 slots for more survival pressure.[/p][/*][*][p]Illegal items now marked in tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Computer calendar shows day and season. Also show employee ID card in computer.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotbar and currency layout cleaned up.[/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 [b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several crashes and null reference errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing materials and broken props.[/p][/*][*][p]Translated a lot more items behind the scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unused assets and settings for performance and better organization.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release 0.15: Comic Rendering
notes.content: [h3]🆕 New[/h3][p]🌐 Gameplay Features[/p][list][*][p][b]Squads[/b]: Characters can form squads, join together, and display squad HUD info.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Creation Overhaul[/b]: DNA sliders, randomization, skill selection, game mode dropdown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chat & Thought System[/b]: In-game character thoughts, chat logs, event notifications.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save System[/b]: Save/load player position, skills, appearance, squad data.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cigarette System[/b]: Cigarettes cause lung cancer; visual improvements to items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Assets & Marketing[/b]: Added Steam capsule images and game logo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loading Screen[/b]: New animated gear and disclaimer visuals.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 Visuals & Art[/p][list][*][p][b]Moebius Visual Pass[/b]: Crosshatching, outlines, skybox, palette, and shader optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Material Cleanup[/b]: Applied and simplified hundreds of materials for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Assets[/b]: Angel statues, skill icons, temperature icon, faction flags.[/p][/*][/list][p]🧪 Testing / Tooling[/p][list][*][p][b]CI Improvements[/b]: Separate workflows, license verification, cron schedules.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Semantic Version Check[/b]: ProjectSettings now auto-tested.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manual CI Triggering[/b]: Added ability to manually dispatch workflows.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Changes[/h3][p]🧩 Systems & Logic[/p][list][*][p][b]Tasks & Activities[/b]: Improved planning logic, fixed NREs, better command tracking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting[/b]: Temporarily disabled until inventory/recipe systems are complete.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Access[/b]: Can now start quests via in-game computer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardcore Mode[/b]: Proper save deletion when player dies.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖌 Visual Tweaks[/p][list][*][p][b]Visual Style Shift[/b]: Switched to darker toon outlines, less bloom, better materials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moebius Shaders[/b]: Stronger outlines, cleaner hatching, improved pattern blending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Polish[/b]: Recolored terrain, fixed emissive issues, improved skybox and lighting.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖥 UI and UX[/p][list][*][p][b]Main Menu Redesign[/b]: Modern look, fixed cameras, new fonts and layout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Portraits[/b]: Headcam rendering improvements and frame design.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buttons & Text[/b]: Consistent button behavior, darker backgrounds, improved readability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chat & Log[/b]: Messages fade, scroll correctly, and include important events and thoughts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Misc UX[/b]: Copy/paste characters, tooltips, window pinning, skill icons, game mode info.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Fixes (Condensed)[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed NREs for spawning, factions, planning, and interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual glitches like missing materials, gender rendering, UI clipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues with shooting logic, camera FOV, prefab overrides.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save/load issues for skills, player position, squad state.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed redundant assets, broken prefabs, and old materials to reduce clutter.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Version 0.12
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] New music
[*] alternative fire modes
[*] a rocket launcher
[*] dashing now gives invulnerability seconds
[*] new base body font (Oxanium) which is easier to read
[*] nice tooltip with weapon details
[*] dismantle factory objects by holding "X" on them
[*] basic ATM banking system to persist money between deaths
[*] basic shop system to allow buying weapons and other materials from NPCs
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] faster movement: 3 dash charges and 2 grappling charges.
[*] Gravity is now 10% stronger
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor UI fixes
[*] Some movement fixes related to jump velocity
[/list]
